assisted.description: Isolated custom scalar opcode drafted by LLM
assisted.action_taken: Single opcode addition; scalar address calculation and load/store bottlenecks persist

driven.description: Aggressive compiler autotuning on static hardware
driven.action_taken: Compiler flag sweep; unrolling exhausts 32-entry register file, triggering 32k spill cycles
driven.tool_provenance: riscv64-linux-gnu-gcc + objdump + qemu-user (Verified 92 stack spills in loop)

native.description: Joint HW/SW co-design: SIMD-4 post-inc hardware + matched vector lowering
native.action_taken: Cross-layer co-adaptation: post-increment addressing eliminates address arithmetic; SIMD vectors eliminate spills
native.compiler_strategy: Matched vectorizer lowering to post-increment primitives
